title: أعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the accursed

title: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

title: سبحان الله وبحمده
translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him

title: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: La ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu'l-mulk wa lahu'l-hamd wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
translation: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the kingdom and His is the praise, and He has power over everything

title: الحمد لله رب العالمين
translation: All praise is due to Allah, Lord of all the worlds
